q: How do I reset my password?
a: Use the Forgot Password link on the sign-in screen and follow the prompts. Reset links expire in 15 minutes.

q: Can I change my Service ID?
a: No. Service IDs are immutable and tied to your record. Contact your unit admin for corrections.
